instance Set.OrdConnected.instTietzeExtension {t : Set ℝ} [t.OrdConnected] [Nonempty t] :
    TietzeExtension t where
  exists_restrict_eq' s hs f := by
    obtain ⟨g, hgt, hgf⟩ := (ContinuousMap.mk (Subtype.val ∘ f) (by fun_prop)).exists_restrict_eq_forall_mem_of_closed
      (fun x ↦ (f x).2) (Set.nonempty_coe_sort.mp ‹_›) hs
    exact ⟨⟨fun x ↦ ⟨g x, hgt x⟩, by fun_prop⟩, by ext x; exact congr($hgf x)⟩

example : TietzeExtension unitInterval := inferInstance
example : TietzeExtension (unitInterval × unitInterval) := inferInstance
